title: Benchmarking Open-Ended Vulnerability Discovery in Windows Kernel Binaries
abstract: arXiv:2611.33486v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier models are increasingly used to discover real-world security vulnerabilities, making it critical to systematically evaluate their cybersecurity capabilities. However, existing security benchmarks primarily focus on known vulnerabilities in open-source projects, largely overlooking closed-source binaries, which underpin much of the software industry. In this paper, we ask: how effective are frontier models at uncovering deep vulnerabilities in production binaries? To answer this question, we present DeepBinary, the first comprehensive benchmark for open-ended vulnerability discovery in Windows kernel binaries. Given a target binary, an agent analyzes it using a disassembler and kernel debugger in network-isolated VMs and reports each vulnerability with a crashing proof of concept (PoC). translated_title: 基准测试Windows内核二进制文件中的开放式漏洞发现
translated_abstract: 前沿模型正越来越多地被用于发现真实世界中的安全漏洞，因此系统性评估其网络安全能力变得至关重要。然而，现有的安全基准主要聚焦于开源项目中的已知漏洞，在很大程度上忽视了支撑软件行业大部分业务的闭源二进制文件。在本文中，我们提出了一个问题：前沿模型在生产级二进制文件中发现深层漏洞的效果究竟如何？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了DeepBinary，这是首个针对Windows内核二进制文件进行开放式漏洞发现的综合性基准。给定一个目标二进制文件，智能体在网络隔离的虚拟机中使用反汇编器和内核调试器对其进行分析，并为每个发现的漏洞报告一个可触发崩溃的概念验证。与现有基准不同，DeepBinary会在全新的虚拟机上重放每一份漏洞报告，并采用基于大语言模型的评判器来评估报告的有效性、唯一性和……
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对Windows内核二进制文件的开放式漏洞发现综合基准DeepBinary，通过让智能体在网络隔离虚拟机中使用反汇编器和内核调试器发现漏洞，并以全新虚拟机重放与LLM评判器验证报告的有效性和唯一性，系统评估了前沿模型在生产级闭源二进制中发现深层漏洞的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DeepBinary, the first comprehensive benchmark for open-ended vulnerability discovery in Windows kernel binaries, where agents analyze production binaries using a disassembler and kernel debugger in network-isolated VMs, and reports are validated through fresh-VM replay and an LLM-based judge to assess validity and uniqueness.
